title: Construction incident or near-miss report
description: A first report of an incident or near miss on a construction project: what happened, when, who was hurt, what was done immediately, whether work was stopped and who has been told. Facts only; causes are left to the investigation. The product carries an exercise mark and is not a safety evaluation of any real structure.

examples: Level 9, east bay, below the tower crane hook
One worker to hospital; two others examined on site
Yes: all work on levels 8 to 10 and under the swing radius
enum: Yes: all work on levels 8 to 10 and under the swing radius

examples: A curtain wall unit slipped from its sling during the pick and landed on the level 8 deck. A worker on the deck was struck by a fragment.
Pick stopped, area cleared, 911 called at 08:54, first aid given, headcount started.
Safety director, project executive. Owner and insurer not yet told. OSHA decision pending.
